coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review `.gitignore` and `llama.cpp.conf` due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete audits and false inconclusive verdicts.
